ok.scope: One employer's payroll tax for the 2026-27 financial year (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027) in one of New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory and the Northern Territory, for an employer that is not a member of a group and paid or was liable to pay wages on every day of the year. The operator establishes the employer's taxable wages in the jurisdiction (the wages its Act makes taxable there, after its exemptions) and its Australian wages (those taxable wages with its interstate wages, the wages taxable in every other jurisdiction), and in Victoria whether it is a regional employer (Payroll Tax Act 2007 (Vic) s 3A). The result is the annual liability under each Act's schedule before any rebate, discount or cap, such as Queensland's regional discount (Payroll Tax Act 1971 (Qld) s 10A) and the 6.85% cap for an eligible university in the ACT (DI2026-151 s 5(c)(i)). Given the payroll tax and any surcharge paid or payable on the year's periodic returns (periodic_tax and, in Queensland, the levy on them, periodic_levy) and, in Victoria, South Australia, Tasmania, the ACT and the Northern Territory, any other refund of payroll tax made for the year (other_refunds, nil if none), it also reconciles the year: what remains payable and what is refunded. The New South Wales reconciliation is refused: its Act could not be read on 26 November 2026.
